title: Slime Unfix
description: Reverts the changes to slime blocks in Minecraft 1.21.2 snapshots and pre-releases
body:
Reverts the changes made to slime blocks in Minecraft 1.21.2 snapshots and pre-releases
The mod is both client-sided and server-sided, and must be installed on both client and server to work properly

Changes:
- Sneaking on slime block deals fall damage
- Holding jump on slime block cancels the bounce
